Sandbox_BSCCraft_BaseArea_tooltip: While standing inside the Base Stock Counter area, crafting can use explored containers anywhere in it, on every floor.
Sandbox_BSCCraft_NearbyRadius_tooltip: Crafting can use explored containers up to this many squares away, on the same floor and in the same building. 0 turns it off.
Sandbox_BSCCraft_MaxBaseContainers_toolt: Most base containers offered to crafting at once, closest first. Lower it if the crafting window gets slow.
